No overlap here.
* 11.1.1 - business logic requirement - check that you can not do steps outside of the flow
* 11.1.2 - anti-automation requirement - check, that some data flows are not automated (massive read/write/delete)
* 11.1.7 - monitoring and logging requirement, belongs to category V7, or V8 (potentially duplicate of 8.1.4), the same applies to 11.1.8

Related issue which may solve this potential confusion: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1211
